liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

Debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, and borrowings due within two years stood at {{borrowings_due_2y@FY2024}}, so the near-term maturities are covered by cash liquidity without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments was {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, down from {{fcf_after_leases@FY2023}} in FY2023, and FCF after leases to debt fell by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}, so cash left for debt holders was negative after leases.

Customer prepayments rose: contract liabilities increased by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, with advance ticket cover up by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow after leases was {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}} and FCF after leases to debt fell by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}}, so the group consumed cash after lease payments.

Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Maturities: debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, against cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2024}} that fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}}.
Margins: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, the weakest of the network airlines ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}).
